concerns.text: Tasks T055 and T060 mandate a 'Hard Halt' and 'No Synthetic Fallback' if real data fetch fails. This directly contradicts the plan.md 'Critical Scope Definition' which explicitly states: 'If no verified open-access dataset... is found... the project will execute on a synthetic dataset to validate the pipeline code'. The tasks silently weaken the approved fallback strategy, violating the plan's constitutional scope.

Task T022 implements 'Permutation Testing' to generate empirical p-values for correlation. The spec (FR-005) and Constitution (Principle VI) strictly require 'Benjamini-Hochberg correction to all correlation p-values' derived from Spearman tests. While permutation is a valid method, the task replaces the mandated BH pipeline with a permutation-based one without explicit authorization in the spec, constituting a semantic weakening of the statistical requirement.

Task T012 implements a memory-based sampling strategy that allows the pipeline to proceed with N < 50 if RAM is constrained (by raising an error only if max_rows < 50). The spec (User Story 1 Edge Cases) and SC-001 mandate that if N < 50, the system must 'halt execution' and report an error. The task's logic allows a 'sampled' path that the spec treats as a hard failure condition, relaxing the sample-size constraint.

Task T025 enforces a hard halt if the significant taxa count is outside '1-20'. The spec (SC-004) defines the expected range as 'low single-digit to higher single-digit' (ambiguous) and does not explicitly mandate a hard halt for out-of-range results in the real data scenario (only for N < 50). The task imposes a stricter, unverified constraint (1-20) that could prematurely abort valid biological findings, violating the spec's acceptance criteria.

Task T034d requires re-running the *entire* outer split and null distribution generation for *each* of the 5 sensitivity thresholds. The plan.md 'Runtime & Resource Estimates' (< 2 hours) and Constitution (Principle VII) imply a strict time budget. Re-computing the full nested CV and null distribution 5 times for a 50-subject cohort with high permutation counts risks exceeding the time limit without a documented trade-off, potentially violating the runtime constraint.
